notes: One row per preserved behavior, custom commit, or runtime dependency required for a no-feature-loss upgrade.
Terminal states allowed per plan: upstream_equivalent_tested | ported_tested | retired_with_marc_approval.
Intermediate states: assumed (default) | test-only (a golden-master check exists but final disposition not yet decided).
Every row must be exercised by at least one automated check or documented manual contract before Phase 2 begins.
Rows may be split with suffixes (for example UM-04a, UM-04b) to give each intent its own explicit contract while preserving the anchor commit SHA.

states.assumed: No golden-master check yet. Must be replaced by one of the terminal states before release.
states.test-only: A golden-master check exists (auto or manual). The final Phase 3/Phase 4 disposition is not yet chosen.
states.upstream_equivalent_tested: Stable v2026.7.1 or later ships a semantically equivalent behavior and it has been tested here.
states.ported_tested: Behavior was ported to the stable target and covered by tests.
states.retired_with_marc_approval: Behavior was intentionally dropped; approval recorded in the row's approvalRef.
